answer: High-water is the default and recommended allocation method for array user shares; it switches to the next drive at half the largest drive's capacity.
The Tunable (md_write_method) setting on Settings -> Disk Settings selects the array write mode, e.g. Read/Modify/Write or Turbo Write (Reconstruct).
Unraid limits the ZFS ARC (read cache) to usually about 1/8th of total RAM.
